panels.title: Verify failure rate
panels.description: runs_total failure / runs_total — only hops that actually executed open_verify. Excludes FIFO queue_timeout / queue_full (see Queue reject / s).

panels.title: Queue reject / s
panels.description: Leaders rejected by FIFO before open_verify (queue_timeout + queue_full). Not counted in runs_total / verify_failures_total.

panels.title: Unhealthy sites
panels.description: Count of sites with site_healthy=0 (EWMA quarantine threshold). In observe mode quarantine does not skip redirects — this is a forecast of enforce behavior, not 'bad redirects saved'.

panels.title: Verify RTT (success mean)
panels.description: Instant mean open_verify RTT for successes only (healthy path). See Verify RTT (mean) chart for success vs failure over time.

panels.title: Positive cache hit ratio
panels.description: hit_positive / all lookups. Excludes hit_negative (known-bad cache; in observe the redirect is still returned).

panels.title: Queue admissions
panels.description: Leaders entering the FIFO: admitted got a slot; queue_timeout / queue_full never ran open_verify. queue_timeout rate is the capacity signal (admitted wait mean is usually ~0 and omitted).

panels.title: Verify RTT (mean)
panels.description: open_verify wall time after FIFO admission (leaders that ran verify). success/failure are real verify outcomes — FIFO rejects are not here (see Queue admissions). Failure mean often sits near VERIFY_TIMEOUT when timeouts dominate; that is still a useful signal.

panels.title: Cache path mix
panels.description: Rate of openverify cache lookups by result. hit_positive skips live verify; miss drives verify; hit_negative is a known-bad cache entry (tried= retry only in enforce mode; in observe the redirect is still returned).

panels.title: Verify outcomes
panels.description: Rate of actual open_verify runs by success/failure (excludes FIFO queue rejects).

panels.title: OpenVerify time penalty (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: OV hop latency quantiles across all outcomes. Spikes near QUEUE_TIMEOUT / VERIFY_TIMEOUT are often rejects or timed-out verifies — filter the delay heatmap by outcome for path split.

panels.title: OpenVerify redirect delay (histogram)
panels.description: Distribution of wall time from SFS_REDIRECT until accept/retry. Filter with Delay outcome: verify_* = actual open_verify; queue_timeout/queue_full = FIFO reject (never verified); cache_hit_*; avoided = quarantine skip (enforce). Does not include cmsd stalls.

panels.title: Site EWMA health (higher = worse)
panels.description: EWMA badness (higher = worse). topk(15) membership can change over time (legend flicker). Updates in observe and enforce; only enforce skips via tried=.

panels.title: Sites → error types (rate)
panels.description: Verify failure reasons (XrdCl / openverify_*) for selected Site(s). This is the failure-type breakdown — complementary to Verify RTT failure mean.

panels.title: Error types → sites (rate)
panels.description: Pick Error reason(s) above to see which sites contribute. Uses $site and $reason filters.

panels.title: cmsd stall duration (histogram)
panels.description: Distribution of cmsd SFS_STALL seconds passed to the client. Buckets: ≤1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, +Inf.

panels.title: Site × error heatmap (avg rate in range)
panels.description: Average verify-failure rate over the dashboard time range (not a timeseries). Rows = site, columns = error reason, cell = avg ops/s. Darker/redder = more problems. Uses rate([...$__range]) so the whole window is one average.

panels.title: Verify failures: site × error (counts in range)
panels.description: Long-form counts (increase over the dashboard time range). Sort by Count. For a site×error matrix colored by average rate, see the heatmap panel above.

panels.title: Site status (scores)
panels.description: Per-site EWMA / healthy flag / verify outcomes over the dashboard time range. healthy=0 can appear in observe without redirects being skipped.

panels.title: Bad redirects saved / s
panels.description: Enforce only: quarantine / negative-cache skips via tried=. Stays ~0 in observe.

panels.title: Avoidance rate
panels.description: Enforce only: avoided / handled. Stays ~0 in observe.

panels.title: Exhausted / s
panels.description: Enforce only: opens that hit max attempts without verify success. Not recorded in observe.

panels.title: OpenVerify success by site attempt
panels.description: Which candidate within each source was accepted (1/2/3). Rucio and cmsd are counted separately. In observe only attempt=1 is possible.

panels.title: OpenVerify accept rate by attempt
panels.description: Rate of opens accepted on the Nth candidate within each source (rucio|cmsd), plus exhausted. exhausted = enforce only: cmsd retry budget spent with no verify success.

panels.title: Avoided / s (total)
panels.description: Sum of quarantine + negative_cache skips via tried=.

panels.title: Accept attempt mix (range)
panels.description: Share of accepted opens (any source) that needed attempt 2 or 3 within that source.

panels.title: Rucio accept share
panels.description: Share of accepted opens whose location came from Rucio (vs cmsd fallback). ~0 when XRD_OPENVERIFY_RUCIO is off.

panels.title: Rucio lookups ok / s
panels.description: Successful list_replicas responses that returned at least one PFN.

panels.title: Rucio soft-fail / s
panels.description: Lookups that fall through to cmsd: empty, auth_error, timeout, or error.

panels.title: PFNs / ok lookup
panels.description: Average Rucio PFN candidates returned per successful lookup.

panels.title: Accepted opens by location source
panels.description: rucio = accepted after Rucio-first path; cmsd = accepted from base OFS/cmsd (including Rucio soft-fail / all-candidates-failed fallback).

panels.title: Rucio lookups by result
panels.description: ok = candidates returned; empty/auth_error/timeout/error = soft-fail to cmsd.

title: OpenVerify — CMS Redirector Ops
description: Operator view for CMS global redirector. Capacity, verify RTT, site×error drill-down, cmsd stalls, Rucio-first locate. Enforce avoidance / accept-by-attempt row is expanded by default.
